en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 7. He said: Abu Hafs Umar ibn Muhammad al-Sayrafi reported to me from Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn al-Husayn al-Soofi, who reported from Abdullah ibn Mutee’, who reported from Khalid ibn Abdillah, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Atiyyah from Ka’b ibn al-Ahbar who said:
"It is written in Torah that whoever does a good turn to a fool, it is an error which is rendered against himself."
And May Allah bless Muhamamad and his pure progeny and send them peaceful greetings.
